203561.overview: Tout Savoir Grande Section Maternelle on DS offers your child the opportunity to test their knowledge and gives them the opportunity to practice writing.  Many themes are offered such as French or even the discovery of the world.  Images and sounds accompany the questions so that your child prepares as well as possible for first grade.

203566.overview: Tout Savoir 3ème offers middle school students the opportunity to revise various subjects such as French, maths, history, geography and many others. Many exercises are present so that your child can prepare for his college certificate in the best conditions. Consult the lessons and understand your mistakes with the help of the corrections proposed at the end of the exercises.

207240.overview:
Touch! Go-Stop DS is a Nintendo DS game which was released on May 29th 2008. Go-Stop is a traditional card game played nationwide in South Korea, played with a hanafuda deck.

In 'Story' mode, you can play a character who attempts to battle his way to become the national Go-Stop champion and earn lots of prize money, competing against 9 AI players. In 'Go-Stop Rule' mode, beginners can easily learn the game by manually changing the rules, and adding distinct 'Character Rules' in order to add more fun to the game. Finally, through the wireless network system of the Nintendo DS, up to 3 players can enjoy the game together with just one copy of the software.

209406.overview: Enjoy two of the most popular versions of solitaire, featuring simple controls and various difficulty levels.Touch Solitaire features two of the most popular versions of the world-famous card game—Spider and Klondike—with simple Touch Screen controls and an easy to understand interface. In Spider, the aim is to arrange cards in piles of a single suit from King down to Ace, thereby removing the pile from play. When all cards are removed, you win the game. The goal of Klondike is to arrange cards from Ace to King in piles, one for each suit, on the four foundations. You win when all cards have been moved to the foundations. Various difficulty levels are available for Spider and Klondike, allowing beginners or experts to enjoy the game at their own pace.

209559.overview: In Tales in a Box, discover a new slant on hidden-object games! Via clever use of the Nintendo DSi system’s inner camera, you can peer ‘into’ the screen, tilting your head to view a scene from different angles, creating an impression of real depth. Journey through a fairy-tale world populated by characters from famous folk stories, and search each themed diorama by looking around from all angles to find hidden letters and objects. As you collect letters and objects, you will meet new characters and form words that will open new stages with even more hidden items to find. Some stages contain secret pictures, testing your observation skills even further. Players of all ages will be amazed by this unique visual spectacle, where a simple-looking picture can reveal a whole world of stories, if you just know where to look!

209919.overview:
GO Series presents Tower of Deus from Tom Create.

Overcome a deadly curse as you race to the top of the tower in this dark, atmospheric, 2D platform game. The only way to release the curse is to run, jump and fly your way to the top of the dreaded tower before the time runs out. There are 40 eerie levels with 10 types of gothic-style graphics, not for the easily scared or faint hearted.

210151.overview: Play 500 puzzles from the 'Telegraph' like you've never played them before! Sudoku, Kakuro, Mini-Sudoku, Sudoku X and Jigsaw Sudoku come in multiple levels of difficulty, with a handy interface that transfigures the classic pen-and-paper experience.

210152.overview: Now you can party with Tetris whenever and wherever you want! Tetris Party Live features several exciting game modes from the popular Tetris Party series, including Marathon (1P), Computer Battle (1P vs CPU), VS Battle (2P), and Duel Space (2P). But the party doesn’t stop there! Take the Tetris fun online via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection, where you can play multiplayer Tetris against up to three other players at a time.

210153.overview:
In Thorium Wars you must stop the Thorions, a super-species of Thorium-powered machines, from destroying mankind. Blast through waves of Thorions by controlling an arsenal of tanks, skyfighters, hovercrafts, gunboats and starfighters with either standard or Touch Screen controls.

Navigate through a variety of combat environments over 12 exciting missions with a 360 degree view of the battlefield, fully rendered in 3D. Toggle between first- and third-person views to destroy the terrifying army of Thorium beasts, ranging from swarms of Redeye Drones to the bone-crushing Manticore Walker. Take control of the outcome in this man vs. machine extreme battle as Thorium Wars proves to be the ultimate test for the survival of the fittest.

210156.overview: Blaze a path across the galaxy in this unique puzzle game. Holding the Nintendo DSi vertically, you must plot a route for your Flametail pod, using its red hot exhaust trail to burn through obstacles on your way to the next planet. Manoeuvre around a maze of blocks to burn them away as your pod passes by to clear the stage. Fortunately, there are plentiful power-ups and items such as the Bomb to blast a wide radius, or Radar which grants you a map to aid your route. In the main Space Tour mode, journey from Earth into outer space on a block-burning and brain-busting voyage. Or set yourself a challenge against the clock in Time Limit mode. Plus – if you achieve a high score, you can even take a photo of yourself with the inner camera of the Nintendo DSi system and show off your winning smile!

210158.overview:
Many untouched caverns still exist in the world, waiting for someone brave enough to explore them. Within them lie vast troves of treasure and rare artefacts.

Become Tyrol the treasure hunter, collect treasures and escape from the caverns. Be warned though – there are creatures lurking in the depths of the caverns, and nature is against you. Use your pickaxe wisely or you'll find yourself trapped and lost forever within the darkness of the caverns.

Can Tyrol collect enough treasure in order to win the heart of the woman he loves?

212982.overview:
Think Again for the Nintendo DS is the second part of the Logik Trainer series that contains training exercises for language, comprehension, maths, memory, logic, three-dimensional reasoning and audiovisual.

Based on the famous and successful German board game license by Ravensburger, Think Again offers different puzzles, riddles and brainteasers that enhance the ability to use both sides of the brain. The player will be guided through the different levels by a character who will comment on the player's results and give advice on how to improve in the various challenges. Furthermore, the player is provided with constant documentation about their learning progress, which is edited graphically and saved for later reviews. In the multiplayer mode, the player gets the chance to compete against friends and family members to figure out who is the biggest brainiac!

Features include the option to adjust the game for a right-handed or a left-handed player, multiplayer (multicard and hotseat) where players can compete in 7 tasks, and 21 new mini-games in 7 different disciplines.

213015.overview: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Conviction Prototype for DS

213205.overview: "TOEIC DS: Haru 10-bun Yakjeomgeukbok +200" is a Nintendo DS game designed to help users improve their English skills for the TOEIC test. It is a Korean title, and the full name translates to "TOEIC DS: 10-Minute Daily Breakthrough +200," implying it offers daily English training content.

213206.overview:
Every year, approximately 160,000 primary school students in year 8 take the Cito test, also known as the "Final Primary Education Test." This test, which provides recommendations for further education, causes many children sleepless nights. Help them ease some of this worry by preparing them well with Math Test Trainer for the Nintendo DS.

Math Test Trainer is an ideal tool for children to playfully familiarize themselves with tests and the multiple-choice question system, and to identify areas where they might need some improvement. With the Nintendo DS, children can practice anytime, anywhere, and work towards a good preparation for the actual Cito test through play.

Math Test Trainer is available in two versions: Language Test Trainer and Math Test Trainer. With Language Test Trainer, children can practice the sections "Language" and "Spelling," or a combination of both. With the Math Test Trainer you can practice the components 'Mental arithmetic' and 'Arithmetic' or a combination of these components.

213207.overview: The test trainer is an ideal tool for children to get acquainted with the tests in a playful way, the system of multiple choice questions and shows which part we can possibly brush up on. With the Nintendo DS, children can practice at any time and anywhere and they can work on a good preparation for the real Cito Test while playing. With Toetstrainer Taal, children can practice on the Language and Spelling components.

213208.overview: Touch Dictionary is a dictionary software title for the Nintendo DS released in 2005 exclusively in South Korea. The dictionary offers translation to and from English, Japanese, and Korean. An advertisement for the game claims it offers 1.63 million words. The user enters the word to translate from the source language using the keyboard on the bottom screen. Above the keyboard, a list of possible source words is displayed. The user can choose between multiple words with similar spelling, such as touch (タッチ, tacchi) and Dutch account (ダッチ・アカウント, dacchi akaunto). The top screen displays the results of the search. The user can scroll between results using an on-screen scroll wheel on the right side of the lower screen. Additionally, the software has a calculator.

213209.overview: Touch: Man to Man - Gicho Yeongeo is an educational video game released for the Nintendo DS in 2010 that focuses on teaching basic English to Korean speakers. Developed by Criware and published by Daewon Media, the title uses the DS touch screen to facilitate interactive language learning.

440240.overview:
Descend the slopes in the craziest snowboard game in history.

What happens when the dragons’ treasures are stolen by goblins whilst you were in charge of watching over them? Big trouble!

With some not-so-happy dragons to answer to, you must recover all of the treasures as fast as possible by taking control of the last guardian and his snowboard in frantic races to recover the stolen treasure. Perfect your best tricks to gain favours from the dragons and discover the invisible chests to complete your task.

440245.overview:
Play crossword puzzles from the 'Telegraph' like you've never played them before!

Play crossword puzzles from the 'Telegraph' like you've never played them before!

Discover a whopping 500 puzzles of multiple types. You're in for many hours of gameplay!

With its handy interface and intuitive controls, this game transfigures the classic pen-and-paper experience.

Notable features include:

• A huge selection of quick puzzles, cryptic puzzles and general knowledge puzzles!
• Registration of best times in the Hall of Fame.
• Interactive hints prevent you from being stuck!
• Auto-save as you go: you can stop and resume a puzzle at any time!

440297.overview: Kurt and Camila are explorers on a mysterious journey to find a lost artifact. You guide them through rooms filled with various dangers, from enemies to rolling boulders. Your main power is the ability to rotate the rooms 90 degrees to the left or to the right. Mastering the law of gravity is essential to your success. Everything and everyone in the room is subjected to gravity and falls when you turn the room. Watch your head! Featuring three worlds with nine levels of about 10 rooms each, the game promises a whole lot of brain-twisting fun on your Nintendo DSi system.

440303.overview: Trajectile is a puzzle game that’s as much about firepower as it is about brainpower, requiring you to line up your shot and launch a flurry of missiles at enemy targets. Three types of missiles are at your disposal, each one with its own characteristics—but all of them can bounce off walls on their path to smash, blast, or drill through enemies and blocks. Along the way, you’ll find item blocks just waiting to be destroyed so that you can obtain special power-ups...and cause even more destruction. Be careful though, as missile type and position are predetermined and you get only a limited number of launches per stage. Complete multiple classes containing numerous individual stages, earning medals when you clear stages in fewer than the given number of turns. Are you ready to take aim at becoming a Trajectile master?

440309.overview: Tee off with power, drive with accuracy, and putt with precision! True Swing Golf Express is a realistic golf simulation that makes full use of the Touch Screen to offer in-depth control over your actions. Vary shot power, apply topspin or backspin, and more, all with a touch of your stylus. Beginners or experts alike can choose from two main modes. Round mode offers play across 3-, 9-, or 18-hole courses, each with varying difficulty levels and some in an exciting tournament setting. Challenge mode puts a unique spin on golf, with a wide selection of special tasks to complete. Completing these tasks in Challenge mode allows you to improve your character’s skills and unlock new courses in Round mode. The fairway awaits!

446760.overview:
This game is a software for English word training that is based on book "Kikutan Basic 4000". From those 4000 words, the game features 1120 most useful words for a basic level training. The game will prepare the player for TOEIC (Test of English for International Communication) test with score range from 350 to 600 points.

The game is designed for daily training, after creating your profile, you are presented with 16 new words every day (they are written and pronounced in both English and Japanese). The word games then vary from translating the word, properly reading the word, multiple-answers selection, or entering the correct word that is missing within the sentence.

464018.overview:
Deceptively Simple, Completely Addictive!

Get ready for a new Tetris challenge, the world's most popular puzzle game is now available on the Nintendo DS!
Challenge a friend to a wireless game of Tetris, or go head-to-head on your Nintendo DS
Use the new touch-screen to control and even draw your Tetriminos
Experience new Tetris variations - Tetris Warning, Tetris Trash, and Draw Tetris
Enjoy Classic Tetris and other familiar Tetris games like Hot Line Tetris and Cascade Tetris

470966.overview:
A Pokémon HeartGold ROM hack that replaces all Pokémon with characters from the Touhou Project game series. It keeps HeartGold's original story but overhauls nearly everything else, making it a fresh experience for both Touhou fans and veterans of older Gen III Touhoumon hacks.

Features:
- All Pokémon are swapped for "puppets" based on Touhou characters, with updated sprites and characters up to Touhou 18
- New type system beyond the standard Gen IV types (e.g., Earth, Reason, Beast)
- New moves to match the new types, and HM/TM improvements (deletable HMs, infinite TMs)
- Quality-of-life upgrades: uncapped vitamins, faster HP bar, 252 EV cap, console compatibility
- A fully working Battle Frontier
- Battle music replaced with Pokémon-style Touhou remixes
